title: Agentic discovery of blood biomarker from distilled private health records
summary: Routine complete blood counts (CBCs) could yield new biomarkers, but the private records needed to evaluate candidates cannot be shared with frontier language model agents that excel at discovery. We distilled the evidence held in the Clalit Health Services panel of over 5.4 million patients into a released scoring tool: for each of 13 immune-mediated diseases, a graph attention network was trained inside the data boundary to predict the case-control AUC of candidate CBC expressions, and only the trained weights were released. The tool grounds an agent's propose-score-refine loop in real-world data without exposing any patient data. In external validation, agent-discovered expressions improved on their literature-seeded starting points by a median of 4.18 AUC percentage points, and across three independent cohorts, reranking the candidates of three frontier research tools improved on their first choices in most comparisons, with gains that varied by cohort. The released scorer supports privacy-preserving biomarker hypothesis generation.
tldr: The paper presents a privacy-preserving agentic framework that distills patient-level evidence from a large private health records database into a released scoring tool, enabling an AI agent to propose, score, and refine candidate CBC-based biomarkers across 13 immune-mediated diseases without exposing raw data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种隐私保护的智能体发现框架：将大型私有健康记录中的证据蒸馏为可公开的评分工具，使AI智能体在不暴露原始患者数据的情况下，对13种免疫介导疾病的CBC候选生物标志物进行提出、评分和优化。
summary_zh: 常规全血细胞计数（CBC）可能产生新的生物标志物，但评估候选标志物所需的私人记录无法共享给擅长发现的前沿语言模型智能体。我们将Clalit医疗服务机构超过540万患者面板中的证据提炼为一种发布的评分工具：针对13种免疫介导疾病中的每一种，在数据边界内训练了一个图注意力网络，用于预测候选CBC表达式的病例对照AUC，并且仅发布训练后的权重。该工具将智能体的“提出-评分-优化”循环锚定在真实世界数据中，而不暴露任何患者数据。在外部验证中，智能体发现的表达式在其文献种子起点的基础上中位提高了4.18个AUC百分点；在三个独立队列中，对三种前沿研究工具的候选结果进行重新排序后，在大多数比较中优于它们的第一选择，收益因队列而异。发布的评分器支持隐私保护的生物标志物假设生成。

title: Same Predictions, Different Harms: Causal Auditing of Patient World Models
summary: Patient world models used for clinical trial simulation can agree on transition kernels and arm-specific risks, yet disagree on the fraction of patients harmed by switching treatment---the counterfactual quantity that matters for intervention-aware reasoning. We audit this reliability gap in a two-stage shared-response SCM: a categorical intermediate health state is followed by common terminal care. Under independent stages, the sharp harm interval has closed-form endpoints for at most three intermediate states, with an exactness boundary at four states. Declared dependence and response-mismatch budgets yield calibrated outer bounds when stage independence or complete mediation is relaxed; in a symmetric three-state model the entire sensitivity frontier is sharp, $[0,\min\{1/2,1/3+(ρ+δ)/2\}]$, and shows exactly how budgets erase the gain over endpoint-only bounds. Two eight-variable response LPs propagate interventional uncertainty for finite-sample audits. Exact witnesses verify attainability. On public clinical simulators (EpiCare; sepsis), native configurations show little resolved stage dependence and no additional joint-compatibility gain over pairwise transport---honest negative results for reliability claims. All experiments are locally reproducible; guarantees remain conditional on the stated causal model. The results provide a concrete protocol for deciding when a patient world model is safe to trust for counterfactual harm.
tldr: This paper audits the reliability of patient world models for clinical trial simulation, showing that models can agree on transition kernels and treatment risks yet disagree on counterfactual patient harm. It derives sharp bounds and finite-sample auditing methods in a two-stage shared-response causal model, and applies them to public clinical simulators.
tldr_zh: 该论文审计了用于临床试验模拟的患者世界模型的可靠性，指出模型可能在转移核和治疗风险上一致，但在反事实患者伤害上不一致。作者在二阶段共享响应因果模型中推导了尖锐边界和有限样本审计方法，并在公共临床模拟器上进行了验证。
summary_zh:
摘要：
用于临床试验模拟的患者世界模型可能在转移核和组别特定风险上达成一致，但在因切换治疗而受损的患者比例上却存在分歧——而这一反事实量正是干预感知推理所关注的关键量。我们在一个两阶段共享响应结构因果模型（SCM）中审计了这一可靠性差距：一个分类中间健康状态之后跟随共同的终末护理。在阶段独立下，精确伤害区间在至多三个中间状态下具有闭式端点，并在四个状态处存在精确性边界。当放宽阶段独立性或完全中介假设时，声明的依赖性和响应不匹配预算可产生校准的外部边界；在对称三状态模型中，整个敏感性前沿是精确的，为\[0,\min\{1/2,1/3+(\rho+\delta)/2\}\]，并精确展示了预算如何消除相对于仅使用端点边界的增益。两个八变量响应线性规划（LP）为有限样本审计传播干预不确定性。精确见证者验证了可达性。在公开的临床模拟器（EpiCare；脓毒症）上，原生配置显示出很少的已解析阶段依赖性，并且相对于成对传输没有额外的联合兼容性增益——这是对可靠性声明的诚实阴性结果。所有实验均可本地复现；保证仍以所陈述的因果模型为条件。这些结果为决定何时可以安全信任患者世界模型用于反事实伤害提供了具体协议。

title: MedImageOSWorld: Benchmarking GUI Agents for Medical Image Consoles
summary: Graphical consoles offer a practical interface for medical acquisition assistance, allowing agents to work through the controls and visual feedback used by human operators. Reliable assistance requires linking on-screen anatomy to acquisition decisions that determine what image evidence becomes available next. We introduce MedImageOSWorld, a benchmark for evaluating this capability in simulated CT, MR, and ultrasound consoles. Using screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions, agents configure protocols, plan acquisitions, inspect the resulting images, and make corrective adjustments across seven capability levels, from console operation to feedback-driven control. Evaluation combines task-specific workflow checks with hidden anatomical ground truth to assess procedural completion and acquisition outcomes separately. A common evaluation protocol specifies episode conditions and interaction budgets, while recorded trajectories support analysis of how agents observe, act, and respond to acquisition feedback. Across eleven open-weight agents, success rates range from 3.0 to 25.0 on a 0-100 scale while workflow-progress rates reach 21.5-74.5: agents complete much of the console workflow but rarely acquire the intended anatomy. Success collapses between perception and planning, from 79-90% at the lowest three levels for the best agent to at most 12% for millimetre-level planning and 0% for closed-loop control among open-weight agents. Two proprietary agents reach success rates of about 34 and exceed the best open-weight agent mainly in acquisition quality (61 versus 42). MedImageOSWorld provides a controlled setting for studying whether general-purpose GUI agents can translate visual observations into effective medical acquisition decisions.
tldr: Introduces MedImageOSWorld, a benchmark for evaluating GUI agents operating simulated CT, MR, and ultrasound consoles via screenshots and mouse/keyboard actions, with seven capability levels and hidden anatomical ground truth. Results show open-weight agents complete much of the workflow but rarely acquire the intended anatomy, while proprietary agents perform better mainly in acquisition quality.
tldr_zh: 提出了MedImageOSWorld，一个用于评估GUI智能体在模拟CT、MR和超声影像控制台上通过截图与鼠标键盘操作完成采集任务的基准，分七个能力层级并利用隐藏解剖学真值评估流程完成度与采集结果。结果显示开放权重智能体流程完成度尚可，但获取目标解剖结构的成功率很低，闭环控制为零；专有智能体表现更好。
summary_zh: 图形控制台为医学采集辅助提供了实用界面，使智能体能够借助人类操作员所用的控制部件和视觉反馈开展工作。可靠的辅助需要将屏幕上的解剖结构与采集决策相关联，因为这些决策决定了接下来可获得哪些影像证据。我们推出了 MedImageOSWorld，这是一个在模拟 CT、MR 和超声控制台中评估该能力的基准。智能体通过截图和鼠标键盘操作，配置协议、规划采集、检查生成的图像，并在从控制台操作到反馈驱动控制的七个能力级别上作出纠正性调整。评估结合了任务特定的工作流检查与隐藏的解剖学真实标注，从而分别评估流程完成情况和采集结果。统一的评估协议规定了回合条件和交互预算，同时记录的轨迹支持分析智能体如何观察、行动以及对采集反馈作出响应。在 11 个开放权重智能体中，成功率在 0-100 分制上介于 3.0 到 25.0，而工作流进展率则达到 21.5-74.5：智能体完成了大部分控制台工作流，但很少采集到目标解剖结构。成功率在感知与规划之间骤降：最佳智能体在最低三个级别上达到 79-90%，但在毫米级规划上至多为 12%，在开放权重智能体的闭环控制上为 0%。两个专有智能体的成功率约为 34，且主要在采集质量上超过最佳开放权重智能体（61 对 42）。MedImageOSWorld 为研究通用 GUI 智能体能否将视觉观察转化为有效的医学采集决策提供了一个受控环境。

title: ARISE: Adaptive Agentic Reasoning with Image-grounded Self-Evaluation for Interpretable IBD Assessment
summary: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) requires frequent imaging-based assessment, yet interpretation of modalities such as wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) and intestinal ultrasound remains heavily dependent on specialist expertise. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate significant potential in multimodal medical image analysis, but their clinical adoption is hindered by their insufficient domain-specific reasoning, susceptibility to hallucination, scarcity of high quality training data in fine-grained diagnostics and limited interpretability. We introduce ARISE (Adaptive Agentic Reasoning with Image-grounded Self-Evaluation), an autonomous planning framework that models few-shot medical image understanding as a sequential agentic workflow. ARISE structures agent execution into a transparent 5-stage workflow: hypothesis generation, image-grounded evidence summarization, evidence-conditioned refinement, symbolic verification, and final diagnosis. We apply ARISE to IBD assessment across two independent patient cohorts: wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) images for Crohn's disease and B-mode ultrasound data for ulcerative colitis. ARISE consistently improves diagnostic performance over baseline VLMs while exposing where reasoning succeeds or fails, providing a more interpretable basis for clinical decision support and realistic deployment.
tldr: ARISE introduces a transparent 5-stage agentic workflow for IBD imaging assessment, using image-grounded self-evaluation and symbolic verification to improve vision-language model reasoning and interpretability across WCE and ultrasound data.
tldr_zh: ARISE 提出了一种透明的五阶段智能体工作流，用于炎症性肠病影像评估，通过图像锚定的自我评估与符号验证提升视觉语言模型的推理能力和可解释性，适用于胶囊内镜和超声数据。
summary_zh: 炎症性肠病（IBD）需要频繁的影像学评估，然而无线胶囊内镜（WCE）和肠道超声等模态的判读仍高度依赖专科医生的经验。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在多模态医学图像分析中展现出巨大潜力，但其临床应用受到领域特定推理能力不足、易产生幻觉、细粒度诊断高质量训练数据稀缺以及可解释性有限的制约。我们提出ARISE（基于图像锚定的自适应智能体推理与自我评估），一种自主规划框架，将少样本医学图像理解建模为顺序化的智能体工作流。ARISE将智能体执行过程组织为透明的5阶段工作流：假设生成、基于图像的证据总结、证据条件化细化、符号验证和最终诊断。我们将ARISE应用于两个独立患者队列的IBD评估：克罗恩病的无线胶囊内镜（WCE）图像和溃疡性结肠炎的B型超声数据。ARISE持续提升了基线VLM的诊断性能，同时揭示了推理成功或失败之处，为临床决策支持和实际部署提供了更可解释的基础。

title: templar: agentic induction and evolution of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora
summary: Structured radiology reporting mitigates the heterogeneity of free-text reports, yet its benefits depend on high-quality reporting templates. In practice, such templates are conventionally built through labor-intensive expert consensus and therefore vary across institutions and lag behind evolving clinical practice. Large language models (LLMs) enable automated template induction, but existing approaches remain limited: single-LLM induction is constrained by context length, and the corpus-scale method ASTAR produces a static, closed-corpus template without external grounding or downstream adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TEMPLAR, a TEMPLate-centric Agentic framework for inducing and evolving standardized Radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora. TEMPLAR treats the template as a persistent central state maintained alongside two provenance-aware knowledge graphs, namely an anatomical graph that constrains template construction and a diagnostic graph that supports finding-to-diagnosis reasoning. Three agents operate on this state. The Induction Agent derives canonical clinical slots from anatomy-constrained Span-Triple atoms via dual-view similarity clustering; the Evolution Agent then assembles these slots into a hierarchical template and revises it under consistency constraints, external clinical evidence, and downstream structuring feedback; and the Clinical Agent applies the evolved template to report structuring, reconstruction, and diagnostic reasoning. Across four datasets, TEMPLAR outperforms ASTAR, three medical LLMs, and six general-purpose LLMs in coverage, information fidelity, and diagnostic fidelity, while achieving the highest or tied-highest LLM-rated template quality. Its fidelity advantages over ASTAR persist under cross-dataset transfer, and cumulative ablations support complementary contributions of its key components.
tldr: Presents TEMPLAR, an agentic framework that induces and evolves standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora by maintaining templates as a central state with anatomical and diagnostic knowledge graphs, outperforming prior methods across four datasets.
tldr_zh: 提出TEMPLAR，一种以模板为中心的代理框架，从大规模临床语料中归纳和演化标准化放射报告模板，结合解剖/诊断知识图谱与多个智能体，在四个数据集上优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 结构化放射学报告减轻了自由文本报告的异质性，但其益处取决于高质量的报告模板。在实践中，此类模板通常通过劳动密集型的专家共识构建，因此在不同机构之间存在差异，并滞后于不断演进的临床实践。大型语言模型（LLM）实现了模板的自动归纳，但现有方法仍然存在局限：单LLM归纳受限于上下文长度，而语料库级方法ASTAR生成的是静态的封闭语料库模板，缺乏外部依据或下游适配。为解决这些局限，我们提出了TEMPLAR，一个以模板为中心的智能体框架，用于从大规模临床语料库中归纳和演进标准化放射学报告模板。TEMPLAR将模板视为持久化的中心状态，并维护两个带有来源追踪的知识图谱，即约束模板构建的解剖图谱和支持从发现到诊断推理的诊断图谱。三个智能体在此状态上运行。归纳智能体通过双视角相似性聚类，从受解剖约束的Span-Triple原子中推导出规范临床槽位；演进智能体随后将这些槽位组装成分层模板，并在一致性约束、外部临床证据和下游结构化反馈下对其进行修订；临床智能体将演进后的模板应用于报告结构化、重建和诊断推理。在四个数据集上，TEMPLAR在覆盖率、信息保真度和诊断保真度方面优于ASTAR、三个医学LLM和六个通用LLM，同时在LLM评分的模板质量上达到最高或并列最高。其相对于ASTAR的保真度优势在跨数据集迁移中持续存在，累计消融实验支持其关键组件的互补贡献。

title: Robot Learning with Visual Predicted Force
summary: Force-aware manipulation typically relies on specialized force or tactile sensors. We show that force-aware manipulation can instead be achieved through visual force prediction from the deformation of a compliant Fin Ray gripper. Our approach trains two models. First, we train a visual force estimator on calibration data and use it to annotate task demonstrations with force estimates. Second, we train an action--force proposal policy on these force-augmented demonstrations to jointly generate candidate robot actions and their associated forces. At test time, we sample candidate actions and the forces they are expected to produce, then execute the action whose predicted force is closest to a target from the demonstrations. We evaluate our approach on berry picking, empty-can grasping, in-hand reorientation, and plug insertion. Our results show that visual force prediction can guide inference-time action selection for contact-rich manipulation without requiring force or tactile sensors at deployment.
tldr: This paper proposes a vision-based force prediction method using the deformation of a compliant Fin Ray gripper, enabling force-aware manipulation without force or tactile sensors. It trains a visual force estimator and an action-force proposal policy, then selects actions whose predicted forces best match demonstration targets, validated on tasks like berry picking, grasping, reorientation, and insertion.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出利用柔性Fin Ray夹爪的视觉形变来预测力，从而在无需力/触觉传感器的情况下实现力感知操作。方法训练视觉力估计器和动作-力联合生成策略，在推理时选择预测力与示范目标最接近的动作，并在摘浆果、抓取、重定向和插拔等任务上验证。
summary_zh: 力感知操作通常依赖于专门的力传感器或触觉传感器。我们表明，力感知操作可以通过利用柔性Fin Ray夹爪的形变进行视觉力预测来实现。我们的方法训练两个模型。首先，我们在标定数据上训练一个视觉力估计器，并利用它为任务演示标注力估计值。其次，我们在这些带有力标注的演示上训练一个动作-力提议策略，以联合生成候选机器人动作及其关联力。在测试时，我们采样候选动作及其预期产生的力，然后执行预测力与演示中目标力最接近的动作。我们在浆果采摘、空罐抓取、手内重新定向和插头插入任务上评估了我们的方法。结果表明，视觉力预测可以在部署时无需力传感器或触觉传感器的情况下，引导接触丰富操作的推理时动作选择。

title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
summary: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.
tldr: Introduces Penumbra, an adaptive adversarial search algorithm that finds minimal-edit response pairs straddling the compliance boundary for regulatory obligations, improving sample efficiency and coverage of failure modes when red-teaming AI agents.
tldr_zh: 提出Penumbra，一种自适应对抗搜索算法，通过生成仅最小编辑差异但分处合规/违规两侧的响应对，以高样本效率覆盖监管义务的失败模式，用于智能体红队测试。
summary_zh:
摘要：

智能体正进入金融、医疗和法律等领域，在这些领域中，违规行为不会留下词汇层面的痕迹，却会带来真实的惩罚。某项遗漏是否重大，某项披露是否充分，取决于回复遗漏了什么。检验此类义务意味着要找到那些仅需一次最小编辑即可使合规性翻转的回复，而每次检验都耗费一次生成和两次裁决，因此监管红队测试的约束条件是样本效率，而非样本数量。我们提出Penumbra，一种对抗性搜索方法，它在不断扩展的编辑预算下从已验证的锚点出发，直到双评估委员会改变其判定，并输出跨越该变化的两条相邻回复。分配是自适应的，目标是覆盖“失效面”：即每个候选所解决的不同（义务×失效模式）单元。在匹配预算下，自适应分配在59%的候选上达到了均匀分配的全部预算覆盖率；在相同记录数下，其覆盖的失效模式是朴素枚举的1.43倍，且增益仅限于其目标维度。在金融咨询章程的60项筛选义务上，Penumbra返回了144对回复，每对包含一条合规回复和一条违规回复，委员会将它们置于边界两侧，二者仅相差几个词，而直接要求模型生成二者时，得到的文本几乎毫无共同之处。针对临床分诊的第二份章程在18项义务上重现了这一结果：在相同严格度下得到49对，且最难的失效模式相同。此类配对揭示了义务自身的条款在何处不再起决定作用，而这正是部署在该义务下的智能体必须接受检验的内容；搜索找到这些配对的成本随边界规模增长，而非随文本规模增长。

title: DNPush: Distributed Nonparallel Pushing Force Control of Multi-Robot Systems for Object Transportation
summary: This letter proposes DNPush, a Distributed Nonparallel Pushing force controller for cooperative object transport without inter-robot communication. Each robot uses local force measurements, a preassigned force weight, and a locally expressed desired transport direction, without requiring an object model, contact locations, a CoM estimate, or moment arm magnitudes online. DNPush regulates nonparallel force magnitudes from local force direction misalignments through a reciprocal-sine law. Under the stated contact conditions, Lyapunov analysis with LaSalle's invariance principle proves convergence to a unique rotational equilibrium, where perpendicular force contributions cancel and the net torque from normal forces is zero. Object velocity converges to the desired transport direction, and suitable contact regions exist for convex polygons. Simulations isolate the reciprocal-sine scaling mechanism, five-robot coordination, and active rotational damping. Hardware experiments with soft tactile differential-drive robots achieve a velocity direction error of 0.61 deg +/- 0.79 deg over five trials with a fixed transport direction and demonstrate object transport through waypoints with three robots.
tldr: DNPush presents a communication-free distributed controller for multi-robot cooperative object pushing; each robot uses local force measurements and a reciprocal-sine law to align object motion with a desired direction. Simulations and hardware experiments with soft tactile differential-drive robots validate convergence and waypoint transport.
tldr_zh: DNPush提出了一种无需机器人间通信的分布式多机器人协同推动控制器，各机器人仅利用局部力测量和反比正弦律使物体运动方向收敛到期望方向，并在软体触觉差分驱动机器人上进行了仿真和实物验证。
summary_zh: 这篇短文提出了DNPush，一种分布式非平行推力控制器，用于在机器人间无通信的情况下协作搬运物体。每个机器人仅利用局部力测量、预分配的力权重和局部表达的期望搬运方向，无需物体模型、接触位置、质心估计或在线力臂大小。DNPush通过互逆正弦定律，根据局部力方向偏差来调节非平行力的大小。在所陈述的接触条件下，利用LaSalle不变集原理的Lyapunov分析证明了收敛到唯一的旋转平衡，在该平衡中垂直力分量相互抵消，法向力产生的净力矩为零。物体速度收敛到期望的搬运方向，且对凸多边形存在合适的接触区域。仿真验证了互逆正弦缩放机制、五机器人协调以及主动旋转阻尼。使用软触觉差动机器人进行的硬件实验中，在固定搬运方向下的五次试验中，速度方向误差为0.61度±0.79度，并展示了三个机器人通过路径点搬运物体的能力。
